input: Renew my passport before it expires

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: How soon the passport expires determines urgency, whether expedited processing is needed, and if emergency appointments are required.
The country of citizenship dictates the exact agency, forms, fees, and procedures involved — the entire process differs by country.
Whether the user needs the passport for an upcoming trip changes priorities — they may need it by a specific date well before expiry, or just want it renewed proactively.
Knowing where the user is in the process (nothing started vs. photos taken vs. forms filled) determines what the immediate next action should be.
If renewing for a child or a dependent, the requirements (parental consent, in-person appearance, different forms) are substantially different from an adult self-renewal.
The user may prefer to handle everything online/by mail vs. visiting an office in person, which affects which renewal route to recommend.
Understanding what a successful outcome looks like — passport in hand by a certain date, minimal cost, minimal effort — shapes how to prioritise trade-offs like cost vs. speed.

gold.taskDescription: The user needs to complete their passport renewal in time before their current passport expires.

questions.title: When exactly does your current passport expire?
questions.description: The expiration date determines urgency and whether standard, expedited, or emergency renewal is the right path.

questions.title: Which country issued your passport?
questions.description: The issuing country defines the agency, forms, fees, and full procedure to follow.

questions.title: Do you have a specific trip or travel date driving this?
questions.description: An upcoming trip creates a hard deadline that may be sooner than the expiry date itself, changing the priority level.

questions.title: How far along in the renewal process are you?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has started (gathered documents, completed photos, filled forms) determines what the very next action should be.

questions.title: Is this renewal for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Renewing for a minor or dependent involves different forms, parental consent rules, and in-person requirements.

questions.title: Do you prefer to handle this by mail or in person?
questions.description: The preferred channel affects which renewal route is recommended and what steps are included in the plan.

questions.title: What matters most — getting it fast or keeping costs low?
questions.description: Expedited processing and courier options cost significantly more; knowing the user's priority shapes which trade-offs to recommend.
